subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable wake/replay runtime and its persistent shared-state contract as part of the beta 3 core stack?
rationale: The PR introduces a new core runtime mode, environment-controlled behavior, persisted contracts, and long-term operational support obligations; repairing the replay defect does not decide whether maintainers want to own this architecture.

options.title: Sponsor the durable stack
options.body: Accept the core direction after the replay defect, upgrade contract, and exact-head live proof are completed across the stack.

options.title: Narrow the foundation
options.body: Keep only minimum generic durable primitives and defer wake-delivery policy until a smaller permanent contract is approved.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Do not merge dependent durable-runtime layers until maintainers select a different ownership or product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable stack
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction after the replay defect, upgrade contract, and exact-head live proof are completed across the stack.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses shared-state, agent, gateway, release, and support ownership, and the adjacent history is most concentrated under this handle.
